site.name: Somnia Magna
site.page_title: Somnia Magna | Bringing dreams to life
site.description: Curated day and night experiences in Toronto, built around people and community instead of the bar.

hero.sub: Curated day and night experiences in Toronto, built around people and community instead of the bar.

about.heading: A third place, after dark.
about.body: Most nights out in this city come down to a drink and a loud room. We think there's room for more than that. Somnia Magna plans events where the point is the people you meet and the thing you came to do, whether or not there's a glass in your hand.

pillars.title: Events
pillars.body: Gatherings planned around what people actually want to do, from the venue to the smallest detail. Day or night.

pillars.title: Partnerships
pillars.body: We work with sponsors, venues and creators who care about the same crowd we do, and build something that fits both sides.

pillars.title: Community
pillars.body: Every event is a reason to come back. The goal is a group of people who keep showing up for each other.

items.title: More than a bar tab
items.body: Drinks can be there. They're never the plan.

items.title: Doors open
items.body: We don't build on velvet ropes. If it sounds like your kind of night, you're invited.

items.title: Room for everyone
items.body: Nobody should have to wonder whether they belong at one of our events.

items.title: Our first gathering
items.blurb: Follow @somniamagna on Instagram to hear about it first.

partners.heading: Build it with us.
partners.body: Sponsors, venues and creators: if you want to reach people looking for something better to do with their evenings, let's talk.

contact.heading: Big dreams, built here.
contact.body: Tell us what you have in mind and we'll get back to you.
